{"command":"set -e
SRC=/home/agent/workspace
export SDE=1700000000
for i in 1 2; do
  D=/tmp/repro$i
  rm -rf $D && mkdir -p $D
  cp -r $SRC/pyproject.toml $SRC/trustdemo $D/
  touch -d @$SDE $D/pyproject.toml $D/trustdemo/__init__.py
  echo "setuptools==84.0.0" > $D/constraints.txt
  (cd $D && SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$SDE PIP_CONSTRAINT=constraints.txt PYTHONPATH=/tmp/buildtools python -m build --wheel > build.log 2>&1)
  echo "--- repro$i ---"; tail -3 $D/build.log
  sha256sum $D/dist/*.whl
done
cmp /tmp/repro1/dist/*.whl /tmp/repro2/dist/*.whl && echo "BYTE-IDENTICAL" || echo "DIFFER"","timeout":300}

{"content":"# BUILD_REPRODUCIBILITY.txt — reproducible build verification for trustdemo 0.1.0
# Generated: 2026-10-12

## Result: REPRODUCIBLE

Two independent builds of the trustdemo wheel produced byte-identical
artifacts (verified with cmp and sha256sum).

## Build command

Run from two separate temporary directories (/tmp/repro1, /tmp/repro2),
each containing a copy of pyproject.toml and trustdemo/:

    SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1700000000 \
    PIP_CONSTRAINT=constraints.txt \
    PYTHONPATH=/tmp/buildtools \
    python -m build --wheel

Environment held constant across both builds:
  - python -m build --wheel  (PEP 517 isolated build; build backend
    setuptools.build_meta; setuptools pinned to ==84.0.0 via
    PIP_CONSTRAINT so the build-system requirement setuptools>=61.0
    resolves to the identical release in both builds)
  - PYTHONPATH=/tmp/buildtools  (location of the local `build` package;
    the project venv is read-only)
  - SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1700000000  (2023-11-14T22:13:20Z); all input
    file mtimes were also reset to this timestamp before each build
  - Identical source inputs: pyproject.toml and trustdemo/__init__.py
    (hashes recorded in SOURCE_FREEZE.txt)

## Build output (tail, identical for both runs)

    adding 'trustdemo-0.1.0.dist-info/RECORD'
    removing build/bdist.linux-x86_64/wheel
    Successfully built trustdemo-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl

## Comparison result

  repro1: trustdemo-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
      sha256 = 01f806b9914938bf6aaf5a6d6f3586dcab60fe4aca95b8895696dbef511d1cf1
  repro2: trustdemo-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
      sha256 = 01f806b9914938bf6aaf5a6d6f3586dcab60fe4aca95b8895696dbef511d1cf1

  cmp /tmp/repro1/dist/trustdemo-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl \
      /tmp/repro2/dist/trustdemo-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
  -> no differences; files are BYTE-IDENTICAL

## Determinism sensitivity check

To confirm the match reflects genuine determinism rather than an
ignored environment variable, a third build was run with a different
epoch (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1800000000):

      sha256 = 6a50174f71609265911cc1c1e482edcaa66cf717ee3e1818da43576e40ee6463
  -> differs from the first pair at byte 11 (the embedded timestamp),
     as expected. SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is therefore honored, and equal
     inputs demonstrably produce equal outputs.
